description:
Show the settings of one of your Nekoweb sites: the folder it serves and whether each option is on.

Options: main (Make this your main site: it's shown when you follow other sites, and your username subdomain redirects to it. Only one site can be main, so this takes it from the current one.); nice_links (Serve /page.html at /page. Turning this off again breaks links that leave out .html.); strict_slash (Only with nice links: /page.html is served only at /page, and /page/index.html only at /page/ (like Neocities).); visible (Show the site in Explore and on Follows pages.); show_in_global_feed (Show the site's RSS posts in the global feed.); support_http (Allow plain HTTP as well as HTTPS.); nsfw (Mark the site as NSFW. It then can't be reached from the UK.)

Requires the optional session token (NEKOWEB_SESSION_TOKEN). If it isn't set, this tool returns setup steps to pass on to the user. Change settings with nekoweb_update_site_settings.

Example: "Is nice links on for my site?" -> {}

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for structured data

site.description: Domain of one of your sites, e.g. 'mysite.nekoweb.org'. Omit for the site the API key belongs to.

name: nekoweb_get_site_settings
title: Get site settings
